name_zh: 南非·德斯蒙德·图图：真相和解与彩虹国家道德权威
name_en: South Africa Desmond Tutu: Truth Reconciliation & Rainbow Nation Moral Authority
description_zh: 德斯蒙德·图图 (1931-2021) 南非圣公会大主教，诺贝尔和平奖得主，真相与和解委员会主席，以基督教宽恕伦理愈合种族创伤，推动彩虹国家建构，反对科尔宾反犹太主义。
description_en: Desmond Tutu (1931-2021) South African Anglican Archbishop, Nobel Peace Prize laureate, Truth and Reconciliation Commission chair, Christian forgiveness ethics healed racial wounds, promoted Rainbow Nation construction, opposed Corbyn antisemitism.
reason_zh: 图图代表宗教道德权威如何在政治转型中提供愈合机制，展示了真相委员会如何通过宽恕而非报复实现社会和解，其彩虹国家愿景成为后冲突社会伦理标杆。
reason_en: Tutu represents how religious moral authority provides healing mechanism in political transition, demonstrating how truth commission achieves social reconciliation through forgiveness not retribution, his Rainbow Nation vision becoming post-conflict society ethical benchmark.
steps_zh: 研究图图早年教师与神学教育反种族隔离觉醒
分析1984年诺贝尔和平奖与国际反种隔声援
探讨1995年真相与和解委员会主席宽恕听证
评估彩虹国家愿景与后曼德拉时代腐败批判
总结真相和解诺贝尔神职彩虹道德对全球转型正义的范式贡献
steps_en: Study Tutu early teacher and theological education anti-apartheid awakening
Analyze 1984 Nobel Peace Prize and international anti-apartheid solidarity
Explore 1995 Truth Reconciliation Commission chair forgiveness hearings
Evaluate Rainbow Nation vision and post-Mandela era corruption critique
Summarize truth reconciliation Nobel clergy rainbow morality paradigm contribution for global transitional justice
expected_zh: 掌握宗教宽恕伦理如何转化为政治和解制度设计，理解真相委员会听证机制如何平衡正义与愈合，评估图图模式对卢旺达塞拉利昂等真相委员会的直接启示。
expected_en: Master how religious forgiveness ethics transforms into political reconciliation institutional design, grasp truth commission hearing mechanism balancing justice and healing, evaluate Tutu model direct lessons for Rwanda Sierra Leone truth commissions.
case_zh: 1984 诺贝尔；1995 真相委员会；彩虹国家；2021 逝世。真相和解诺贝尔神职彩虹道德范式永存。
case_en: 1984 Nobel; 1995 TRC; Rainbow Nation; 2021 death. Truth reconciliation Nobel clergy rainbow morality paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Truth commission; forgiveness; Rainbow Nation; transitional justice
